title: Audio
description: A generated speech clip of at most 2 seconds.

id.description: Unique identifier of the audio object.

text.description: Text the speech is generated from. Must be short enough to be spoken in at most 2 seconds.

emotion.description: Emotion the text is spoken with (free text for now, e.g. "joyful", "eerie", "angry").

clipUrl.description: Public CDN URL of the mp3 file (CDN to be decided).
